meta.name: training-llms-megatron
meta.description: Trains large language models (2B-462B parameters) using NVIDIA Megatron-Core with advanced parallelism strategies. Use when training models >1B parameters, need maximum GPU efficiency (47% MFU on H100), or require tensor/pipeline/sequence/context/expert parallelism. Production-ready framework used for Nemotron, LLaMA, DeepSeek.

copy.tagline: 用Megatron-Core训练百亿参数大语言模型
copy.tagline_en: Train large language models with Megatron-Core parallelism
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to train LLMs over 1B parameters with maximum GPU efficiency

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你配置并启动大规模语言模型的分布式训练，支持 2B 到 462B 参数，使用 NVIDIA Megatron-Core 和多种并行策略。
howto.when: 当你需要训练参数量超过 10B 的模型，或追求 GPU 利用率超过 40% 时触发。

say.text: 如何为 Mixtral 8x7B 设置专家并行训练？
say.note: Claude 会给出专家并行大小和 MoE 超参数配置。

say.text: 训练 405B 模型时，如何选择并行策略？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you configure and launch distributed training of large language models (2B to 462B parameters) using NVIDIA Megatron-Core with advanced parallelism strategies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to train models larger than 10B parameters or aim for GPU utilization above 40%.

say_en.text: Help me configure a training script for LLaMA 70B using 64 H100 GPUs.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a training command with tensor and pipeline parallelism.

say_en.text: How to set up expert parallelism for Mixtral 8x7B?
say_en.note: Claude will provide expert parallel size and MoE hyperparameters.

say_en.text: What parallelism strategy should I use for a 405B model?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend TP=8, PP=8, CP=2, etc.
